# thisparam

<!-- badges: start -->
[![Lifecycle: experimental](https://img.shields.io/badge/lifecycle-experimental-orange.svg)](https://lifecycle.r-lib.org/articles/stages.html#experimental)
[![CRAN status](https://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/thisparam)](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=thisparam)
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/turtletopia/thisparam/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/turtletopia/thisparam/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)

The goal of thisparam is to provide test specifications as counterparts to [{checkmate}](https://github.com/mllg/checkmate) assertions.

## Installation

You can install the development version of thisparam from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("turtletopia/thisparam")
```
